description: The Unpack Raycast Hit node takes in a RaycastHit and gives the separate components of that hit. One source of this data is RaycastAll.

fields.HitDistance: The distance from the Origin to the hit point in global coordinate space.
fields.HitPoint: The global position at which the ray hit the collider.
fields.HitNormal: The facing normal direction of the hit collider at the hit point.
fields.HitTriangleIndex: The triangle index on the mesh corresponding to the hit collider. This value is 0 unless the HitCollider is a MeshCollider.
